title: Has anyone here tried Nubra's trading API?
author: tradingguy588
selftext:
I'm curious if anyone here has used Nubra for algo trading or building automated strategies. How has your experience been so far, especially with the API documentation, market data, and order execution?

Would love to hear some honest feedback from people who've actually tried it. (not promotional, Im just tryna search Zerodha alts that are free :/)

comments.author: Shoddy_Peanut7320
comments.body: I haven't used Nubra, so I can't speak to it, but if you're comparing brokers' APIs, three tests tell you most of what you need. Time how long the market data takes to reach you against another feed, check what happens when you send an order twice or the connection drops mid-order, and read how it counts rate limits and daily order caps. Whatever you try, run it on paper or tiny size for a couple of weeks before you trust it with real money. Cymetica's Exchange Connections page is one place to see how strategies get linked to exchanges.

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: haven't used Nubra, so no real feedback on that one. what I'd check on any free broker API before writing code against it is how it reports a rejected order, that's usually where the cheap ones get vague.
